reviews.text: I received excellent and kind service when my dog ​​suddenly became ill, and I would like to make this my regular veterinarian.

My beloved cat, who suffered from hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, received care at this clinic for about a year and a half.

At every visit, the doctors and staff provided incredibly professional and attentive care. Even though my Japanese isn't very good, they always patiently listened to me and explained things clearly, for which I am truly grateful.

My cat passed away recently, but I will never forget the kind and supportive care I received for so long. Thank you so much for taking such good care of her until the very end.
I went to a different hospital because I was a little uneasy about going to my usual one, but the female doctor's explanation was very thorough, and she was very knowledgeable and wonderful.

I used this clinic for my cat's spaying surgery at the beginning of this year.

I recently moved to the neighborhood, and I learned about this clinic as a local option. I was worried about whether they could handle it since it's a specialist clinic, but the reputation seemed good, so I decided to go with them.

It turned out to be the right decision.

This is my first time owning a cat, so I was full of worries and anxieties. However, the staff were very polite, the veterinarians were kind and helpful, and the vice-director who performed the surgery not only answered my questions but also provided advice on a wide range of topics, including daily care, behavior, and environmental preparation.

Thanks to them, a huge weight was lifted off my shoulders. I will continue to use their services in the future.
I only went in for a vaccination, but they examined my pet very carefully. It's a very reassuring animal hospital.

I think the price is a little on the high side.

There are only four seats in the waiting room, so you have to wait outside even if it's hot.

This is the veterinary clinic for my cat, who is 11 years old this year.

I first brought her here a year ago when she was unwell, and I've found it to be a very trustworthy hospital.

They understand my anxieties, and they sincerely answer even my worst-case scenario questions. Not only the doctor, but all the veterinarians who assist us are very kind and attentive.

There aren't many animal hospitals in Otsuka, but this is a trustworthy one, so I recommend checking them out if you're looking for one.

I use this clinic as my cat's regular veterinarian.

There are two veterinarians on staff, so if you make an appointment, there's little wait time, and the process from examination to payment is very smooth.

During the examination, they clearly explain your pet's condition, possible causes, and necessary tests and treatments, including costs, and they are considerate enough to help you make a decision that you are happy with. I feel that they are a very rational and judgmental veterinarian, so I can leave my pet's care in their hands with peace of mind.

Since the examinations go so smoothly, I also make sure to take notes of my pet's condition in advance and communicate them concisely.

I think they are a trustworthy veterinarian who accurately communicates what is necessary.

The waiting area is a bit compact, so pets that are not good with other animals may need a little caution, but on the other hand, the flow within the clinic is very efficient and helpful.
I would like to continue using them for my cat's health care.
